title: 第十一章 镇退群徒第十二章 直面执事
content_zh:
林间死寂一瞬。
倒地的矮个弟子捂着胸口在草坡上呛出一口浊气，整个人脑子都是懵的。
从出手、被挡、再被震飞，全程不到两秒。
快，快得完全不给人反应的余地。
剩下四名青岚宗弟子脸上的戏谑彻底碎干净，取而代之的是发自心底的紧绷。
领头的高个青年叫赵凯，是这几人里修为最高、脾气最躁的一个。他死死盯着前方布衣少年，眼底的轻视彻底变成阴鸷。
“有点藏拙的本事。”
他咬着牙出声，声音压得很低。
原本只当是个随便拿捏的流民废物，现在他终于看清——对方绝对是正经修士，而且实战手感极稳，根本不是那些野路子散修能比的。
但也就仅此而已。
在他眼里，再能打，顶天也就是个炼气巅峰。
他们四人联手，压一个单修，怎么都稳赢。
“装神弄鬼。”
赵凯手腕一翻，指尖灵气骤然绷紧，青白微光瞬间凝实。
风声猛地一紧。
他不废话，脚下碎石被蹬得崩飞，整个人骤然前冲，掌风直接撕裂空气。
青风掌！
宗门基础掌法，在炼气后期的修为催动下，力道被催到极致，掌风刚猛霸道，直拍烬孤宸面门，角度刁钻，完全是奔着伤人立威去的。
旁边三名弟子见状，也不再观望。
三人同时提速，灵气尽数铺开，从左、右、后三个方位包抄堵截，掌劲、腿风齐齐压上，封死所有闪避空间。

四人合围，招式瞬间落地。
换做普通炼气巅峰修士，这一刻必然被逼得狼狈格挡、节节败退。
可烬孤宸站在原地，半步未移。
他眼神很静，静静看着四道扑面而来的攻势。
炼气境的灵气波动、招式轨迹、发力破绽，在他眼里慢得离谱，清晰得一览无余。
筑基与炼气的差距，从来不是花哨的异象，是本质层级的碾压。
灵气纯度、肉身根基、经脉承载、发力层次，完全不在一个维度。
就在四道攻势贴身的刹那。
烬孤宸动了。
没有前摇，没有蓄力，动作干脆得吓人。
他抬掌，不偏不倚，正面对上赵凯全力拍出的掌风。
单薄的手掌，硬生生接下这刚猛一击。
嘭！！
content_en:
There was a moment of dead silence in the forest.
The short disciple who fell to the ground covered his chest and choked on the grassy slope. His whole mind was confused.
From taking the shot, being blocked, and being knocked away again, the whole process took less than two seconds.
Fast, so fast that there is no room for reaction.
The joking on the faces of the remaining four Qinglan Sect disciples was completely wiped out, replaced by tension from the bottom of their hearts.
The tall young man in the lead is called Zhao Kai. He is the one with the highest cultivation level and the most irritable temper among these people. He stared intently at the commoner boy in front of him, and the contempt in his eyes turned into a sinister look.
"A bit of a hidden talent."
He gritted his teeth and spoke in a low voice.
At first, he just thought he was a random trash, but now he finally saw it clearly - the other party was definitely a serious monk, and his actual combat skills were extremely stable, which was not comparable to those wild casual cultivators.
But that's about it.
In his eyes, no matter how good he is in fighting, Dingtian will be at the peak of Qi refining.
The four of them teamed up to defeat a single cultivator, and they were sure to win no matter what.
"Pretend to be a ghost."
Zhao Kai flipped his wrist, the spiritual energy on his fingertips suddenly tightened, and the blue-white light suddenly solidified.
The sound of wind suddenly tightened.
He didn't talk nonsense, the gravel beneath his feet was kicked away, and he suddenly rushed forward, the wind of his palm directly tearing the air.
Green Wind Palm!
The sect's basic palm technique, stimulated by the cultivation in the later stage of Qi refining, pushed the strength to the extreme. The palm wind was fierce and domineering, hitting Jin Guchen directly in the face, with a tricky angle, completely aimed at hurting people and establishing power.
When the three disciples nearby saw this, they stopped watching.
The three of them increased their speed at the same time, spreading all their spiritual energy, outflanking and intercepting from three directions: left, right and back. Their palms and legs were pressed together, sealing off all dodge space.
The four people surrounded him, and the moves landed instantly.
If it were an ordinary monk at the peak of Qi Refining, he would be forced to block and retreat in panic at this moment.
Ke Jin Guchen stood there without moving even half a step.
His eyes were very quiet, watching the four attacks coming towards him.
In the Qi Refining Realm, the spiritual energy fluctuations, movement trajectories, and power flaws were both ridiculously slow and clear to him.
The difference between foundation building and Qi refining is never a fancy phenomenon, but a crushing of the essence.
The purity of spiritual energy, the foundation of the physical body, the carrying capacity of the meridians, and the level of power generation are not in the same dimension at all.
At the moment when the four attacks were close to him.
Jin Guchen moved.
There is no forward swing, no power accumulation, and the movements are frighteningly crisp.
He raised his palm and faced Zhao Kai's palm blow with all his strength.
His thin palm took the hard blow.
Bang! !
